issue: Boiler diverter valve quote £450 at 19 Castelnau

body:
From: Tom Whitfield <tom.whitfield@example.com>
To: maintenance@riverbank-lettings.example.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 11:40:03 +0100
Subject: Re: Boiler at 19 Castelnau — quote attached, can you go ahead?

Hi,

Following on from the engineer's visit last Friday. As you know the boiler
has been making a loud whirring noise when the hot water kicks in, and the
heating sometimes takes a couple of goes to come on in the morning. The
chap from Thames Heating had a look and says the diverter valve is on its
way out and the pump is "tired". He's quoted £450 all in to replace both
(quote attached).

To be clear, the boiler IS still working. We have hot water and the heating
comes on, it's just noisy and a bit temperamental. He said it would
probably limp on for a while but could fail without warning, and he'd
rather do it now than get a call at 7am in December.

Given we've got two kids and it's October, we'd obviously like this done
sooner rather than later. Can you authorise it and book him in? He said he
could do Thursday or Friday next week. We're flexible on time.

Thanks,
Tom

Tom Whitfield
19 Castelnau, Barnes SW13 9RU
07700 900606

input.subject: Boiler diverter valve + pump replacement — £450 quote (Thames Heating, Q-2026-1187)
input.rationale: Vaillant ecoTEC combi (2020) at 19 Castelnau: Thames Heating Engineers (Gas Safe 598877) attended 3 Oct 2026 and quote £450 inc VAT to replace the diverter valve (£185) and pump (£165) plus labour (£100). Their written findings: diverter valve sticking, pump bearings noisy, no leaks, no fault codes, flue and gas rate in tolerance, "appliance remains safe to use in the meantime". Tenant confirms heating and hot water are still working but noisy and slow to start. This is £450 against your £250 standing cap, so it needs your decision (APR-SPEND-OVER-CAP); it is not an emergency, so I have not dispatched. Relevant context: October, 2 adults and 2 children in occupation, so risk of a mid-winter failure is worth weighing. Your standing instructions prefer Hampton Plumbing & Heating (C-001), who do cover SW — I can ask them for a comparison quote before any booking if you prefer. Thames Heating offer Thursday 16 or Friday 17 October; nothing is booked. Please reply approve / decline / get a second quote.

summary: Hello Tom, thanks for your email of 7 October about the boiler at 19 Castelnau — received and logged today. The quote is £450, which is above the amount we can authorise without the landlord, so I have sent it to him today with the engineer's findings and asked for a decision. I have not booked anything yet, so please treat Thursday 16 / Friday 17 October as provisional only — I will come back to you to agree a time as soon as I have his answer, and I will chase if I have not heard by Friday 10 October. In the meantime the engineer's written report says the appliance remains safe to use. If the heating or hot water does stop working, or you smell gas or hear anything new, please contact us straight away (gas smell: leave the property and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999) — a loss of heating or hot water is treated as an emergency and handled immediately. Separately, your locksmith appointment for the front door lock remains booked for Saturday 10 October at 09:00. Riverbank Lettings
